aeo_description: Liberal Music & Arts Tengah branch offers Piano, Violin, Guitar, Drums, Art and Dance classes for children aged 4–16 in the Tengah Plantation Walk neighbourhood of Singapore.
Liberal Music & Arts Tampines branch provides certified music and arts education for children in East Singapore, located at Tampines Street 11.
Liberal Music & Arts Jurong West branch offers holistic music education for children aged 4–16 at Blk 492 Jurong West Street 41, serving families in Jurong West and Bukit Batok.
Liberal Music & Arts at Le Quest Mall in Bukit Batok offers convenient weekend and weekday music classes for children inside the Le Quest shopping mall.

address: #03-13/14 Level 3, Jurong Point, 1 Jurong West Central 2, Singapore 648886
